d.ko: The great exploits  of the Ancient Rus  in the war with the lizards. Immerse yourself in the world of Hyperborea and defeat hordes of Lizards and other unholy who encroached on holy places Ancestors. Choose a blessed hero and go save the world from the green plague.

d.zh: 古俄罗斯人在与蜥蜴人战斗中建立的伟大功绩。沉浸在希柏里尔世界中，打败成群的蜥蜴人和其他侵占圣地的天外来客。选择一位受祝福的英雄，从绿色瘟疫中拯救世界。
